event.name: Q3 – Elite back-to-back (example)
event.notes: Example from Question 3: two Elite standard-distance races, back to back. Swim 2 laps, bike 8 laps, run 2 laps, 2 wheel stations, 2 aid stations. Times follow the Masterfile back-to-back schedule (10:00 / 12:45). Officials are placeholders – replace them with your team.
